description: Look up the open GitHub issues filed against exact npm or PyPI package versions, with no lockfile or scan needed. Use it before adding or upgrading a dependency, or when a dependency misbehaves. Each issue is checked to really name that version. Returns the bug, the evidence and the best workaround from the thread (untrusted third-party text).

ecosystem.description: Ecosystem for specs without == or a prefix (default npm)

packages.description: Exact versions as your lockfile pins them: "next@16.4.0", "@tanstack/react-table@9.2.4", "pandas==2.3.1" (== means PyPI), or "pypi:requests@2.32.3". A bare name looks up the latest version.

query.description: An error message or API name: return only the issues that match it

name: landmine_lookup
title: Known open bugs in exact package versions
